title: The Guaracci Experiment
author: Jake O.
desc: 12 week program to get Ant Musclemaxxed.

ex.note: Bottom half of movement only with 2 sec pause in the bottom
You can pick between these and lateral raises
Whichever variation you like one that allows you to wear straps
Wear straps
Single arm track only the side you start with (but still 1 set each arm) so 2 total sets
Try to keep your upper arm glued to the pad if doing a preacher curl, If doing another curl try to keep your arm in place (I recommend preachers or a machine)

Line up your knees with the point of rotation to avoid unnecessary tension on your knee joint. 
(Single Leg - 2 sets each leg)
(Weighted obviously)
